Mr. Vikas Bahuguna, Advocate for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Sagar Kothari, Advocate for the 
Caveator/respondent no.1.
3. Since respondent no.1 is a contesting party in the suit, 
therefore, no notices are required to be issued to other 
respondents.
4. This writ petition has been filed under Article 227 of 
the Constitution of India to challenge the judgment and 
order dated 08.04.2025, passed by learned IInd Additional 
Civil Judge (S.D.), Dehradun in Misc. Case No.100 of 2024, 
Dharmendra Kumar Sharma Vs. Ashok Kumar and others, 
whereby the application moved by the petitioner for setting 
aside the ex parte judgment and order dated 07.10.2023 
was rejected, being time barred.
5. Learned counsel for respondent no.1 prays for and is 
granted four weeks’ time for filing counter affidavit.
6. List this case on 16.02.2026.
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 09.12.2025
